llm_response.reason: The website https://zero.mainica.ru.com/ perfectly imitates the visual and textual content of Google's main search page, but is hosted on an unrelated, non-official third-level domain (mainica.ru.com) that is not affiliated with Google. This is a textbook example of scam characteristic #16 (mimicry or spoofing of legitimate companies) and is a common technique in phishing and technical support scams intended to steal credentials or mislead users. There is no indication of a real business or legitimate purpose. The WHOIS data confirms it is not Google owned. The website serves no legitimate function, and its design serves to deceive users.
